description.value: Café salade de fruits is a French bistro tucked into Vancouver's Fairview neighbourhood at the corner of Fir Street and West 7th Avenue. It offers dine-in lunch and dinner service in a neighbourhood-bistro setting. Cyclists riding the nearby Seaside Greenway or the Arbutus Corridor will find it a convenient midday or evening stop for French-inspired cuisine.
